# Leinss Consulting

> Business-process automation for German-speaking small and mid-sized companies (Mittelstand). n8n, AI, and clean system integrations that cut manual work, built, documented, and handed to your team with no vendor lock-in. Solo consultant, DSGVO-compliant, based in Baden-Württemberg, Germany. Works in German and English.

Leinss Consulting automates repetitive work across four areas: CRM & sales, document & data workflows, communication, and system/API integrations. Every engagement is scoped to pay for itself in time saved or errors avoided, and the client keeps full ownership of the workflows. The site hosts five live, interactive AI demos you can run in the browser on your own input, the exact n8n workflows behind them as downloadable JSON, four reference builds documenting the architecture node by node, and one case study of a real client engagement.

The site is bilingual: German pages live under `/de/`, English under `/en/`. English URLs are listed below; replace `/en/` with `/de/` for the German equivalent.

## Services
- [CRM & Sales Automation](https://consulting.leinss.xyz/en/services/crm-sales-automation/): Lead scoring, smart assignment, multi-channel follow-ups, pipeline-stage automation, real-time CRM sync.
- [Document & Data Workflows](https://consulting.leinss.xyz/en/services/document-workflows/): Invoice extraction and booking, automated report generation, contract data extraction, form processing, approval workflows.
- [Communication Automation](https://consulting.leinss.xyz/en/services/communication-automation/): Customer onboarding sequences, intelligent ticket routing, appointment reminders, status notifications, feedback/NPS automation.
- [Integrations & APIs](https://consulting.leinss.xyz/en/services/integrations-apis/): Real-time CRM↔ERP sync, e-commerce integration, custom API development, webhook triggers, data-warehouse reporting.

## Live demos, reference builds & case studies
- [Projects & live AI demos](https://consulting.leinss.xyz/en/projects/): AI invoice reader, lightning lead response, meeting-minutes bot, spreadsheet rescue, AI support assistant. Each one runs live on your own input, and ships the n8n workflow it runs on.

## Blog
- [Automation blog](https://consulting.leinss.xyz/en/blog/): Practical, no-code-friendly guides on automating SMB processes with n8n and AI (CRM, documents, communication, integrations), plus reference builds and one real client case study.
